patchNotes: Driving Mode now uses phone GPS for live speed and heading even without an OBD adapter.
Phone HUD and bundled XREAL vehicle overlay now share one live telemetry session.
Google Maps and Waze route guidance continues through the notification-access bridge.
OBD-II remains optional enrichment for RPM, coolant temperature, engine load, voltage, fuel and vehicle speed.
Bundled XREAL vehicle mode requests location access when needed and follows live GPS, route and OBD state.
Lil ICARUS remains tied to assistant listening, thinking, speaking, action and error states.
Reviewed Android phone actions and wake-word support remain enabled in the installed app.
